_comment: Altium-class BOM features layered on top of bom.py. All knobs here. NO YAML, NO hardcoded values in Python. Edit this file (and conventions.json / bom_config.json) to change behaviour.

bomdoc._comment: Persistent BOM doc lives next to the .kicad_sch as <project>.bomdoc.json. Survives re-renders and stores user overrides + AI-resolution cache.

manufacturer_map._comment: Datasheet URL host → canonical manufacturer name. First match wins (longest host wins on ties). Unknown hosts fall through to AI resolver. Add freely.

distributors._comment: Ranked list of distributors. Index 0 = preferred. AI uses this list when proposing a primary supplier. India-first ordering by default — reorder for your shop.
distributors._currency_comment: AI returns prices in this currency. Use ISO codes (USD/INR/EUR). Conversion is not done — the value is whatever you ask for.

quantity_breaks._comment: Default discount tiers the BOM applies when distributor data is unknown (AI estimate or cached unit price only). Tier = qty threshold; discount applied to extended price. Set discounts to all 0 to disable.

lifecycle._comment: Allowed lifecycle states. AI reports one of these per part. validate_rows flags non-Active states.

ai_resolver._comment: Claude prompts and limits for resolving MPN/Mfr/Price/Lifecycle. The system prompt lives in `system`. The user prompt template uses {placeholders}. Model + max tokens flow through claude_client.
ai_resolver._cache_comment: Resolved fields are written into <project>.bomdoc.json. Subsequent runs are 0 Claude calls unless the user runs --refresh.
ai_resolver.system: You are an electronics procurement assistant. Given a KiCad symbol's library data (lib_id, value, footprint, description, datasheet URL), return the most likely orderable Manufacturer Part Number, the manufacturer, a typical unit price (in {currency}, single-piece quantity), the lifecycle state, and 1-3 alternate orderable MPNs. Be concise. Return ONLY a JSON object — no prose, no fences, no commentary. If unsure, say so via lifecycle:"Unknown" and confidence:"low". Never invent a part number that does not exist.

validation._comment: Health-scorecard thresholds. Surfaced by validate_rows + the text/HTML report.

variants._comment: Assembly variants. 'default' is always built. Add variants whose `dnp_refs` overrides which references are NOT populated for that variant. KiCad 9 assembly variants are read automatically when present; this section is the manual fallback for KiCad 7/8.

default.description: Primary build — every non-DNP component populated.

bom_types._comment: Subset/order of columns per BOM kind. Column keys must exist in csv_columns of bom_config.json OR in the extras list below.

extra_columns._comment: Headers for columns introduced by the bomdoc/AI layer. csv_columns in bom_config.json covers the base columns; these add the procurement-grade ones.

xlsx._comment: Excel export. Requires openpyxl (already in your env if installed; the writer raises a clear error otherwise).
xlsx._summary_comment: When true, a second sheet 'Summary' carries totals + health scorecard.

html._comment: HTML export styling — embedded inline so the file is portable.
html.title: Bill of Materials

report._comment: What goes into the printable scorecard at the bottom of `bom ... --bom-type full` output.
